name: Shin Seizonritsu 0%! Chikatetsu Kara no Dasshutsu
original_name: 新･生存率0％！地下鉄からの脱出
source:
The midnight subway. 14 passengers, strangers to one another, board the last train for their own reasons. However, the train suddenly loses control, carrying them straight into a nightmare...

One by one, the passengers begin to die. "Is the murderer one of us!?"

Surrounded by paranoia and doubt, can you escape this subway of death...?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4753680/Subway_0_Escape/]Steam[/url]]
